selected_concept.economic_question: Does the recency of a newly available quarterly disclosure create short-lived information attention or post-disclosure drift that remains relevant from the next open through the third close?
selected_concept.economic_hypothesis: More recently effective quarterly disclosures concentrate new firm-specific information and investor attention. A monotone decay in disclosure freshness may therefore rank three-session continuation without using any price, return, activity, or terminal factor value.
selected_concept.availability_rule: A disclosure becomes usable only on the first accepted local session strictly after announcement_date. At each signal close use only the most recent effective disclosure whose effective session is no later than that signal session.
selected_concept.why_60_sessions: Sixty accepted sessions is a fixed approximate quarter-length information-decay scale, selected before values with no window search.
